note: UI Editor views stage 2 fix: 'Reset to Desktop view' moves from the quick bar into a banner above the preview in Tablet and Phone. B01 to B10; the prefix B is used by no earlier spec file. retiredChecks and amendments apply to the real page and --stub14 only. The truth numbers of B07 are those of validate-views2.mjs (28 of 28), unchanged.

vocabulary.note: as specs-views2.json, plus: step snapshotStage {name} (the top of the stage area, of the device frame and of the preview, in page coordinates), step snapshotBanner {name} (the banner's height), step focusControl {name} also names the banner's button; assert bannerState {view, state: absent|follows|changed, name?} (see section 5 of docs/ui-editor-gate-rules-views2-banner.md), assert stageSame {against, tol}, assert bannerHeightSame {against, tol}, assert bannerOneLine {width}; assert frames gains stageTopSame (the preview's top is one value in every frame and equals its value at the start); assert layoutBaseline gains noNew (no button is new in the bar).

H04.reason: every check reads the icon button in the quick bar ('Reset to Desktop view' as a bar button, present, enabled, its tooltip, disabled in an SVG): the icon button is gone, the banner replaces it.
H04.replacedBy: B02, B03 (where the control is and what it says in each state)

H13.reason: it expects the quick bar to gain one new button, 'Reset to Desktop view', in Tablet and Phone: the bar is main's again.
H13.replacedBy: B01 (the same layout comparison, with no new button)

U04.reason: the stage's top edge is the same after switching from Desktop to Tablet: the banner is in the flow above the preview in Tablet and Phone (Max's decision), so the stage starts one banner lower there (62 px at 1280) than in Desktop. The ribbon-height checks, the selecting, deselecting and edit-message checks stay.
U04.replacedBy: B04 (the stage does not move within a view when it gets its first change, Undo, Redo or reset)

specs.name: The quick bar is main's: at 1000, 1280, 1440 and 1920 px in Desktop, Tablet and Phone no ribbon group moves (0.5 px), the bar has the same rows and height, every button is where it was (0.5 px) and no button is new; with changes in Phone and Tablet its names are main's with ', customised' on the two views and no Reset to Desktop view, in the bar's tab order too
No banner in Desktop, in an SVG document (Tablet and Phone, upright and sideways) or when no document is open

The banner in Tablet and Phone, upright and sideways: 'Phone follows Desktop. Changes you make here apply to Phone only.' with no button before any change; after a Phone edit it says 'This Phone view has changes that don't follow Desktop. Reset to Desktop view removes them.' with the button while Tablet still follows; a Desktop edit and the content edits (Text, Note, Delete, Insert) change nothing; Undo, Redo and Reset all update it

The stage does not move: the device frame's top and the preview's top stay within 0.5 px, and no frame of the replay shows a different top, at the first edit, the first Undo, the Redo and the reset in Phone and in Tablet (and the reset in sideways Tablet)

The banner is as high with changes as without, in Phone and Tablet at 1280, 1000 and 768 px of window (0.5 px), and one line high at 1280 and 1000 px (at 768 px the 91-character sentence and the button cannot share one line in 14 px type, so it wraps there, to the same reserved height)

The banner's button opens the confirm dialog (the same words and buttons as before); Keep editing changes nothing (list and bytes), leaves the banner as it was and the focus goes back to the banner's button

has: Reset the Phone view to the Desktop setup?
removes the changes made in Phone only
Desktop and the other small view are untouched

specs.name: Confirm in Phone resets only Phone (the Phone range back to the Desktop-scaled 40.9091 px from plain Chromium, Desktop 60 and Tablet 30 untouched, the text stays, the export equals the engine's export of the list without the Phone edits), the focus goes to the Phone button and the banner says it follows Desktop; the same in Tablet

steps.text: Phone view reset to the Desktop setup

specs.name: One Undo after the banner's reset restores the exact bytes, the list and the banner; one Redo re-applies it; Reset all still clears everything

steps.text: Phone view reset to the Desktop setup

specs.name: Keyboard: the banner's button is the next stop after the ribbon's last control (Grid spacing) and before the preview, opens the dialog with Enter and with Space, and Keep editing gives the focus back to it; the banner is a group named 'About the Phone view'
